method: Combined peer-reviewed CC-BY Quaternary & deglacial ice-sheet reconstructions: Batchelor et al. (2019, CC BY 4.0) Northern Hemisphere best-estimate polygons (~3 Ma to 30 ka); paired DATED-1 (Hughes et al. 2016, CC BY 3.0) Eurasia + NADI-1 OPTIMAL (Dalton et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0) North America (25–10 ka); NADI-1 retreating North American domes & persistent Greenland/High Arctic reference (9–1 ka through 1900 CE). Polygons simplified for continuous web mapping; ring winding normalized via D3 spherical area.

slices.label: Pliocene–Pleistocene ~3.0 Ma (Late Gauss 3.59–2.6 Ma)
slices.note: Extensive Fennoscandian/Barents and early Cordilleran/Greenland ice

slices.label: Early Pleistocene ~2.2 Ma (Early Matuyama 2.6–1.78 Ma)
slices.note: Onset of major Northern Hemisphere glaciations; early Laurentide & Eurasian sheets

slices.label: Mid-Pleistocene Transition (~900–790 ka · MIS 20–24)
slices.note: First 100-kyr deep glacial cycles crossing North American & Eurasian lowlands

slices.label: MIS 16 Extreme Glacial (~650 ka · 677–622 ka)
slices.note: Severe cold stage expanding Laurentide and Eurasian ice south of 50°N

slices.label: Elsterian / Anglian Glacial (~450 ka · MIS 12)
slices.note: Deepest Mid-Pleistocene glacial (~450 ka), cutting British-Irish–Channel landscapes

slices.label: MIS 10 Glacial (~350 ka · 365–337 ka)
slices.note: Extensive North American & Eurasian ice margins during Homo heidelbergensis period

slices.label: MIS 8 Glacial (~260 ka · 279–243 ka)
slices.note: Moderate glacial stage before the Saalian expansion

slices.label: Saalian / Illinoian Glacial (~140 ka · MIS 6)
slices.note: Vast Eurasian & Dnieper/Don ice lobes coinciding with early Neanderthal & African MSA

slices.label: Early Last Glacial Stadial (~112 ka · MIS 5d)
slices.note: Renewed Laurentide, Barents and Scandinavian inception after MIS 5e

slices.label: MIS 5b Stadial (~89 ka · 92–86 ka)
slices.note: Pre-Würm / Early Wisconsinan ice expansion

slices.label: MIS 4 Cold Stadial (~65 ka · 72–58 ka)
slices.note: Major pre-LGM cooling (~65 ka) exposing Sahul, Sunda and Beringian shelves

slices.label: MIS 3 Interstadial Ice Sheets (45 ka)
slices.note: Retreated Scandinavian & reduced Laurentide margins (~45 ka)

slices.label: 40 ka Ice Sheets (MIS 3)
slices.note: 40 ka Northern Hemisphere best-estimate configuration

slices.label: 35 ka Ice Sheets (Late MIS 3)
slices.note: Ice advancing toward Late Glacial Maximum across Canada & Fennoscandia

slices.label: 30 ka Ice Sheets (Early MIS 2)
slices.note: Rapid buildup toward Last Glacial Maximum (~30 ka)

slices.label: 25 ka (23,050 BCE)
slices.note: Paired NADI-1 North American OPTIMAL + DATED-1 Eurasian most-credible ice margins at 25 ka cal BP.

slices.label: 23 ka (21,050 BCE)
slices.note: Paired NADI-1 North American OPTIMAL + DATED-1 Eurasian most-credible ice margins at 23 ka cal BP.

slices.label: 21 ka (19,050 BCE)
slices.note: Last Glacial Maximum peak (~21 ka): Laurentide–Cordilleran sheet unites across Canada; Fennoscandian & British-Irish sheets peak; ~−125 m sea level exposes Beringia, Sundaland & Doggerland.

slices.label: 19 ka (17,050 BCE)
slices.note: Paired NADI-1 North American OPTIMAL + DATED-1 Eurasian most-credible ice margins at 19 ka cal BP.

slices.label: 17 ka (15,050 BCE)
slices.note: Paired NADI-1 North American OPTIMAL + DATED-1 Eurasian most-credible ice margins at 17 ka cal BP.

slices.label: 15 ka (13,050 BCE)
slices.note: Early deglaciation (15 ka): Bølling–Allerød warming begins rapid margin retreat and Meltwater Pulse 1A.

slices.label: 13 ka (11,050 BCE)
slices.note: Paired NADI-1 North American OPTIMAL + DATED-1 Eurasian most-credible ice margins at 13 ka cal BP.

slices.label: 12 ka (10,050 BCE)
slices.note: Younger Dryas cold reversal (~12 ka): Fennoscandian and Laurentide retreat stalls briefly in the Ra / Salpausselkä moraines.

slices.label: 11 ka (9,050 BCE)
slices.note: Paired NADI-1 North American OPTIMAL + DATED-1 Eurasian most-credible ice margins at 11 ka cal BP.

slices.label: 10 ka (8,050 BCE)
slices.note: Early Holocene (10 ka): Fennoscandian ice nearly gone; Doggerland lowland still exposed across the southern North Sea.

slices.label: 9 ka (-7049 BCE)
slices.note: Laurentide ice splits around Hudson Bay; Scandinavian ice sheet melted.

slices.label: 8 ka (-6049 BCE)
slices.note: Drainage of glacial Lake Agassiz–Ojibway triggers the 8.2 ka cold event.

slices.label: 7 ka (-5049 BCE)
slices.note: Residual Labrador–Baffin domes collapse; Doggerland and Torres Strait inundated.

slices.label: 6 ka (-4049 BCE)
slices.note: Mid-Holocene Thermal Maximum: only Baffin, Ellesmere and Greenland ice persist (plus Alpine/polar caps).

slices.label: 4 ka (-2049 BCE)
slices.note: Neoglacial cooling begins; Arctic ice close to modern extent.

slices.label: Holocene–1900 CE Persistent Ice Caps
slices.note: Persistent Greenland & High Arctic ice caps reference (0.05–1 ka, carrying through 1900 CE).
